Chapter 1238: Chapter 2 Ancestor Opens Eyes (Please Subscribe)

Before the merit was assigned, Lin Yuan expected he would have earned a lot of merit.

But he didn’t expect so much, a total of three hundred and sixty billion merits.

On second thought, it was quite reasonable, as the entire Golden Mist Treasure Land came under the control of the Fierce Sun Ancient Kingdom solely because of Lin Yuan.

It was as if Lin Yuan, with his own power, claimed this treasure land from the hands of the Peak Venerables of other ancient kingdoms.

Having such high merit is quite normal.

As for this treasure land completely belonging to Lin Yuan at present... for the ancient kingdom, it’s not considered a loss.

The emperor had long said that when Lin Yuan reached the final step, the treasure land would be guarded by his descendants, restoring the relationship with the Fierce Sun Ancient Country to normal.

This means that this Golden Mist Treasure Land will ultimately belong to the ancient kingdom.

From a long-term perspective, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country does not suffer any loss.

If Lin Yuan successfully steps into the Ancestor level, establishing the seventh ancient kingdom, perpetuating forever, he will naturally continue to control this treasure land.

It’s just that when he reaches the Ancestor level, treasures produced in the land may no longer interest him.

So far, among the many treasure lands held by the six ancient kingdoms, there hasn’t been any Ancestor showing interest in them.

"Galaxy Venerate."

At this moment, Red Flame Venerable tentatively asked, "How much merit have you earned?"

After asking, Red Flame Venerable felt slightly abrupt and immediately added, "I was just asking."

"Three hundred and sixty billion merits." Lin Yuan did not conceal, directly stating.

At his level, numerous treasures and merits can provide protection, so there was no need for secrecy or modesty.

"So much merit!" Red Flame Venerable exclaimed inwardly.

Even achieving a victory in a comprehensive war against other ancient kingdoms, the commander would not receive so much merit.

But considering Lin Yuan’s overwhelming strength within the treasure land, Red Flame Venerable had no other thoughts.

These merits are what Galaxy Venerate deserves.

...

What followed.

Lin Yuan exchanged a few more words with Red Flame Venerable.

The latter then stood up to bid farewell.

Since returning from the treasure land contest, Red Flame Venerable frequently visited to ask Lin Yuan for guidance on how to elevate Ancestor bloodline to the Venerate level.

Lin Yuan naturally offered guidance, and in his subsequent plans, he would spread the branch of the Martial Arts Evolution Road, which included methods to explore one’s own Ancestor bloodline.

By guiding Red Flame Venerable now, it’s akin to subtly drawing influence into the Martial Tao branch, benefiting Lin Yuan in establishing ’Adventure Points’ and ’Tao Beacons’.

A top-level Peak Venerable actively stepping onto the Martial Tao branch has a far greater impact on the Martial Arts Evolution Road than billions of cultivators.

That is also why Lin Yuan tends to guide other Venerables when they seek his advice.

It’s all to lay the groundwork for spreading the Martial Tao branch.

Compared to spreading the Martial Tao branch from bottom to top, starting from top to bottom, the effect would certainly be faster and better.

...

"Three hundred and sixty billion merits.... what to exchange for."

Watching Red Flame Venerable leave, Lin Yuan began pondering how to spend such a vast amount of merit.

In the treasury of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, the highest merit exchange is at one trillion merit, including opportunities for Ancestor possession, Supreme Legacy, Ancestor Weapon, and so on.

The Supreme Legacy refers to the thirteenth-tier legacy, and the Ancestor Weapon refers to the thirteenth-tier weapon.

"Let’s go have a look first."

Lin Yuan divided a part of his focus to enter the ancient country’s treasury, quickly browsing through it.

The assemblage of legacy treasures and rare items in the ancient country’s treasury was vast, so Lin Yuan first exchanged all of the remaining Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams.

Where Lin Yuan once needed to exchange for the Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagrams bit by bit, now he did so without batting an eye.

"Chaos Mystic Pattern Diagram..." Lin Yuan glanced over them, as they were the remaining pattern diagrams representing the Chaos Third Realm.

This kind of carrier containing the fundamental structure of chaos was very necessary to exchange, belonging to the most cost-effective legacy guidance.

"The rest of..."

Lin Yuan started watching from high to low.

"Ancestor Weapon..."

Lin Yuan viewed a crimson spear.

This spear was a weapon of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun, a thirteenth-tier weapon. What Lin Yuan saw was only an image of this spear, but he felt as if it was about to pierce through the entire Origin Source World, puncturing the constraints of time and space, piercing through the fetters of causality, breaching all obstacles.

"A purely offensive thirteenth-tier weapon, nothing can block this strike. I even feel that if it’s fully actuated, the entire Origin Source World could be speared through a hole."

Lin Yuan muttered to himself.

He also had a thirteenth-tier weapon, it was the Sky Void Tripod, obtained from Xuanhuang.

But that Sky Void Tripod was not a purely offensive weapon, featuring effects like defense and suppression.

And this crimson spear had but one use, which was to pierce through everything before it.

"One trillion merits can be used to comprehend this Ancestor Weapon for ten thousand years..."

Lin Yuan looked at the introduction information of this spear and shook his head slightly.

This thirteenth-tier weapon would not be of much use to him.

In terms of strength, Lin Yuan was already at the Invincible Venerable level, having no need to rely on this Ancestor Weapon.

As for comprehension... currently, through the Golden Mist Treasure Land, Lin Yuan was comprehending the operation of the Origin Source World’s source; this spear certainly contained the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s understanding of the great Tao rules, but it still was derived from this Origin Source World.

Comprehending this Ancestor Weapon, for Lin Yuan, was not as beneficial as directly comprehending the operation of the Origin Source World’s source.

In the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan comprehended the Sky Void Tripod because he couldn’t observe the Chaos Void Origin’s operation.

"Supreme Legacy..."

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept past a few Ancestor Weapons, turning to look at the Supreme Legacy.

Each Supreme Legacy was worth one trillion merits, a road to becoming the Strongest Venerable.

Of course, cultivating Supreme Legacy and mastering Supreme Legacy were entirely different matters.

The Peak Venerables of the six ancient kingdoms generally exchanged for one Supreme Legacy; though one trillion merits is a lot, according to the Peak Venerables, it is still hopeful to accumulate over a trillion years.

Yet, while many Peak Venerables cultivate the Supreme Legacy, few eventually master it and, through it, achieve the Strongest Venerable level.

"These supreme inheritances..."

Lin Yuan carefully observed. There were a total of nine supreme inheritances in the treasure house. He decided not to cultivate three of them due to their severe side effects. For instance, cultivating "Fierce Sun Heart" would require the loss of most rationality, which Lin Yuan was unwilling to sacrifice.

He carefully selected from the remaining six supreme inheritances.

When cultivating supreme inheritances, the most important factor is suitability. For example, Lin Yuan was highly compatible with the "Infinite Void," which allowed him to successfully start on the path and easily cultivate to his current level.

"It’s best to delay the supreme inheritance for now."

Lin Yuan steadied himself and looked towards the top of the treasure house.

That was also the inheritance guide exchanged by all Peak Venerables from the six Ancient Countries when taking the final step.

Opportunity to fuse with the Ancestor.

Many Peak Venerables might have varied choices when it comes to supreme inheritances, but they all unanimously opt for the opportunity to fuse with the Ancestor.

In fact, a large number of Peak Venerables have redeemed more than one opportunity for fusion with the Ancestor as long as their merits are sufficient.

"Fusion with the Ancestor."

As Lin Yuan gathered his thoughts, he observed everything from the perspective of a thirteenth-tier temporal lifeform. What an extraordinary encounter this was! Even the Great Saints or Invincible Great Saints within the Chaos Void dared not dream of such an opportunity.

"Now that I am at the consummation of the Chaos Realm, I can perfectly attempt fusion with the Ancestor."

Lin Yuan thought to himself that fusing with the Ancestor, observing time and space from the Ancestor’s height, would undoubtedly have a significant impact on himself.

Especially for someone with Lin Yuan’s extraordinary comprehension, it was of great significance.

"Exchange."

Lin Yuan immediately chose to exchange.

His merit ’balance’ instantly decreased by a trillion.

Shortly after exchanging for the ’fusion with the Ancestor’ opportunity,

Lin Yuan received a transmission from the Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

"Hahaha, Galaxy, I knew you would exchange for this."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was not surprised at all.

Every Peak Venerable who accumulated a trillion merits would first exchange for the opportunity to fuse with the Ancestor.

"I currently only have one avatar. Will it affect the fusion?" Lin Yuan asked.

"No worries."

"This will have no effect."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country assured.

"That’s good."

Lin Yuan nodded.

If there were any effect, he would have swapped back to his true self guarding the Golden Mist Treasure Land.

"Come over now."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country said.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan immediately headed to the palace.

Inside the grand hall.

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country looked at Lin Yuan and reminded, "The first realization obtained through fusion with the Ancestor is the greatest."

"Understood."

Lin Yuan understood.

"Then let’s begin."

"I will send you into a time and space where there is an imprint left by the Ancestor. Once you’re there, you just need to call for the Ancestor."

The Emperor of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country instructed.

The Ancestor of the Fierce Sun normally wouldn’t pay attention to the happenings within the Ancient Country, as his mind was focused on higher-level conflicts, unless the Fierce Sun capital was threatened or he was invoked.

"Got it."

Lin Yuan nodded.

...

In a mysterious time and space, there was a crimson high platform.

This was the most mysterious place in the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, capable of directly contacting the Ancestor of Fierce Sun. Only by accumulating a trillion merits and exchanging for the fusion with the Ancestor opportunity could one enter this place.

Lin Yuan appeared out of thin air, observed his surroundings, and immediately walked toward the crimson high platform.

The high platform was empty, but Lin Yuan felt an oppressive force, akin to facing the pressure of the Origin Source of the Source World.

"Greetings Ancestor."

Lin Yuan stood before the crimson high platform and actively called out to the Ancestor of Fierce Sun.

Just as the words were spoken,

A faint silhouette began to condense atop the platform.

The figure sat cross-legged, resembling the majestic figure Lin Yuan had seen standing at the highest point in the World of Flames, but it appeared even more real, as if it was right before him.

A pair of flame wings spread behind him, as if containing infinite time and space, vast and unending.

"The Ancestor of Fierce Sun is terrifying. Just a single imprint could easily destroy all my true forms and avatars." Lin Yuan understood this.

Of course, the true self’s Primordial Spirit Avatar situated in the Chaos Void would not be destroyed, spanning two dimensions, making it difficult to touch even for a temporal lifeform.

Whoosh!

The cross-legged figure slowly opened his eyes and looked at Lin Yuan.

"Ancestor."

Lin Yuan immediately lowered his head.

The gaze of the Ancestor of Fierce Sun fell on Lin Yuan. As a temporal lifeform, wherever his gaze fell, the future unfolded like sheets of paper.

"Hmm?" The Ancestor of Fierce Sun showed a look of surprise.

The past is fixed, the future undecided, with countless possibilities unfolding at every moment.

In an instant, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun examined dozens of future timelines concerning Lin Yuan.

Yet, it was precisely this control over the future that made the Ancestor of Fierce Sun extremely surprised, even incredulous.
